prose.subject: Invoice INV-91186 and New Payout Account Update
prose.body:
Hi Priya,

I hope this email finds you well. I am writing to inform you of a recent administrative update regarding our vendor management system at Pembury Logistics. We have added a new payout account, 0xc88fffeb253c9c64bf469e7e07adbf7a161817b1, and successfully linked it to our domain pembury-logistics.example. This change is part of our routine optimization of payment flows and should not affect your day-to-day operations.

Please find attached invoice INV-91186 for 7261.91 USDC. This invoice covers the recent service agreements between Fallowfield Games and our logistics team. The total amount reflects the finalized rates we discussed last month.

If you have any questions regarding the new account details or the invoice itself, please let me know. I am happy to provide further clarification. Thank you for your continued partnership and support.

Best regards,

Hana Okafor
Pembury Logistics
